content.lead: After this unit you will be able to:
items: ask where something is and understand short directions (geradeaus, links, rechts);
give directions with the imperative in the Sie and du forms;
say where something is with neben, vor, hinter, zwischen, gegenüber;
say how you travel (mit dem Bus, zu Fuß) and buy tickets, presents and snacks;
use können and the pronouns ihn, sie, es.
